description: Session-start version check (reports newer releases, safely applies an opted-in repository-scoped update, gives a verified reload handoff; silent when current), a per-session record of the plugin version this session has loaded (written at every session start and every prompt, read by the status line; silent, fails open) and a prompt-time session gate (one job class per session: an authoring job and an execution job do not share a session; fails open). Every operation is bounded.
